# jsQR 1.4.0, vendored unedited

From the npm package `jsqr@1.4.0` (https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR), `dist/jsQR.js`, Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE` beside it).
Read on 6 November 2026 by dev@PrompTugal.dinis. Used by the sign-in page (`assets/login/login.js`) to read a key's
QR code from the camera or an image, only where the browser has no BarcodeDetector; loaded on demand, never on
every page. The gate (feature `login`) recomputes the hash and fails if the file was edited.
